name: Magpie of Omens

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Familiar block (CR 1). Bond ritual: 10 minutes with materials worth 100+ gp (crystal or gemstone shards); the Familiar Bond rules (bonded sympathy, channel magic, telepathic connection, 1-hour revival) are on page 580 and are listed once in the notes file.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.summary: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

bonus_actions.name: Bonded Voice
bonus_actions.summary: Forms or dissolves a bond with a willing creature within 5 ft; the bonded creature can speak through the magpie in its own voice and language (birdlike lilt). Ends on the creature's death or a new bond.

reactions.name: One for Sorrow
reactions.trigger: A creature within 30 ft makes a D20 Test with Advantage.
reactions.summary: Once a day: when a creature within 30 ft makes a D20 Test with Advantage, it rolls 1d6 and subtracts it from the total.

reactions.name: Two for Joy
reactions.trigger: The magpie or another creature within 30 ft makes an ability check or saving throw.
reactions.summary: Twice a day: when the magpie or a creature within 30 ft makes an ability check or save, it rolls 1d4 and adds it to the total.

summary: A black-and-white bird of fortune: it pecks with bright radiance and lends or takes luck from nearby rolls.
